messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — need to lock down the HelioSoft customer story interview permissions and webinar routing. HelioSoft PR wants quote approvals and a product demo slot in the webinar. Brief: https://redwood.docs/heliosoft-case-brief :calendar:
Jamal: Can do. Proposed interview window next Tue/Thu morning. Which quote lines do we need legal to clear?
Sara: I'll draft the pull quote and send to Helio for redlines. Embargo?
Alyssa: Target embargo May 12. Legal signoff needed by May 5. Also we need to route inbound webinar leads to AE queue 'helio-ops' during the broadcast.
Leo: I can handle legal review. Add me to the doc and tag the specific quote lines with [LEGAL].
Sara: Added Leo and flagged the three quote lines. Draft snippet: "Redwood Inference reduced inference costs by 42% for HelioSoft." Is that OK or too specific?
Leo: Prefer more conservative language: "a significant reduction in inference unit cost" unless Helio provides an explicit percent in writing. If they sign the % in an email we can include it.
Matt: For routing: I'll map webinar registration to the SFDC campaign 'Helio-Q2' and set lead assignment to the queue 'salesteam/helio-ops'. Will coordinate with Ops to ensure the webhook runs.
Alyssa: Jamal — can you lock interviews with Helio VP Eng and the product lead? Also create a calendar placeholder with the webinar slot.
Jamal: On it. I'll propose three times today. Also planning to record the session for a short promo clip — need consent checkbox on registration form.
Alyssa: Yes please add consent language. Sara, can you draft the consent copy? @Leo, if Helio legal requests an NDA for transcripts, will that change the timeline?
Leo: NDA is fine but could add 3–5 days. If they ask, tag me and I'll prioritize.
deploy-bot: calendar event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Sara: Draft quote sent to Helio for redline. Will update doc when they respond.
Alyssa: Awesome. TL;DR: legal review queued, interview slots pending, reg form updated to route to AE queue, embargo May 12. Next check-in EOD. :thumbsup:
